train_net_train: train a SlowFast video classification model for many epochs on the training set and evaluate on validation set
build_trainer_model: build a SlowFast video classification trainer with model, optimizer, dataloaders, and meters from config
train_net_train_epoch: train a SlowFast video classification model for one epoch with mixed precision and mixup augmentation
eval_epoch_validate: evaluate a SlowFast video classification model on the validation set and log top-1 and top-5 errors
calculate_precise_bn_stats: calculate and update precise batch normalization statistics over multiple training iterations
